### pltr api ontologies linked-object get-linked-object

Get a specific linked object that originates from another object.

`pltr api ontologies linked-object get-linked-object ONTOLOGY OBJECT_TYPE PRIMARY_KEY LINK_TYPE LINKED_OBJECT_PRIMARY_KEY [OPTIONS]`

- `ONTOLOGY`: OntologyIdentifier.
- `OBJECT_TYPE`: The API name of the object type.
- `PRIMARY_KEY`: The primary key of the object from which the links originate.
- `LINK_TYPE`: The API name of the link that exists between the object and the requested objects.
- `LINKED_OBJECT_PRIMARY_KEY`: The primary key of the requested linked object.
- Options: `--branch` TEXT, `--exclude-rid`, `--load-ontology-defined-derived-properties`, `--sdk-package-rid` TEXT, `--sdk-version` TEXT, `--select` TEXT
- SDK: `ontologies.LinkedObject.get_linked_object`
